answer_1.quote: In text summarization, manual evaluation, as exemplified by the Pyramid method, is the gold-standard in evaluation.

answer_2.quote: automatic evaluation metrics, such as ROUGE, JS-2, S3, BERTScore, Mover-Score etc.

answer_4.quote: We follow a 3-step process to collect human judgments: (1) we collect system-generated summaries on the most-commonly used summarization dataset, CNNDM; (2) we select representative test samples from CNNDM and (3) we manually evaluate system-generated summaries of the above-selected test samples.
answer_4.guideline: each worker annotates up to 16 SCUs by marking an SCU 'present' if it can be inferred from the system summary or 'not present' otherwise.
